BitbucketInput.description: The input required to create a Bitbucket integration.

Code.description: The OAuth 2.0 authorization code returned from the consent redirect.

InstallationId.description: The Atlassian installation identifier, available from the Atlassian administration console.

State.description: The CSRF state token echoed back from the OAuth redirect.

Workspace.description: The Bitbucket workspace slug that identifies the workspace to integrate.

ConfluenceInput.description: The input required to create a Confluence integration.

Code.description: The OAuth 2.0 authorization code returned from the consent redirect.

InstallationId.description: The Atlassian installation identifier, available from the Atlassian administration console.

SiteUrl.description: The Confluence Cloud site URL, for example https://mysite.atlassian.net.

State.description: The CSRF state token echoed back from the OAuth redirect.

GitHubInput.description: The input required to create a GitHub integration.

Code.description: The OAuth authorization code received from GitHub.

InstallationId.description: The installation identifier provided by GitHub Enterprise Server on the install callback. Required for GitHub Enterprise Server integrations and ignored for GitHub.com.

OrganizationName.description: The name of the GitHub organization to integrate with.

State.description: The CSRF state token for validating the OAuth flow.

TargetUrl.description: The HTTPS URL of a self-hosted GitHub Enterprise Server instance. Omit this value for GitHub.com.

GitLabInput.description: The input required to create a GitLab integration.

AccessToken.description: The GitLab access token used to authenticate. This can be a personal access token or a group access token.

GroupId.description: The identifier of the GitLab group. Required when TokenType is GROUP and ignored for personal tokens.

TargetUrl.description: The HTTPS URL of a self-managed GitLab instance. Omit this value for GitLab SaaS (gitlab.com).

TokenType.description: The type of GitLab access token.

ProviderInput.description: The provider-specific input required to create the integration. Exactly one of the provider input objects must be specified.

Tag.description: A key-value pair to associate with a resource.

Key.description: The key name of the tag.

schema.description: Resource Type definition for AWS::SecurityAgent::Integration. Creates a connection between Security Agent and a third-party provider for code review and remediation.

Arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the integration.

DisplayName.description: The display name for the integration.

InstallationId.description: The installation identifier from the integration provider.

IntegrationId.description: The unique identifier of the integration.

KmsKeyId.description: The identifier of the AWS KMS key to use for encrypting data associated with the integration. Can be a key ID, key ARN, alias name, or alias ARN.

PrivateConnectionName.description: The name of an active private connection used to reach a self-hosted provider instance over private networking.

ProviderType.description: The type of the integration provider.

Tags.description: The tags to associate with the integration.

TargetUrl.description: The HTTPS URL of the customer self-hosted instance, such as a GitHub Enterprise Server or self-managed GitLab instance. This value is absent for SaaS integrations.
